axes (comorbidity = axis-overlap, pleiotropy = one mechanism loading multiple
axes). The discriminating tests: (a) REGISTRY ECONOMY -- count claim-registry
entries needed to represent N syndromes plus their comorbid combinations;
ANSWER 'vector representation preferred' if (B) represents comorbidities as
overlapping axis activation with NO combinatorial blow-up (entry count grows
~linearly in axes, not in syndrome-pairs) while (A) needs a new locus per
combination; ANSWER 'locus mapping adequate' if (B) does not reduce entry
count or loses syndrome-specific discriminability. (b)
PREDISPOSITION/EXPRESSION FACTORING -- the vector must keep 'which axes are
fragile' (axis-predisposition) separable from 'which failure mode is currently
expressed' (gated by developmental timing / plasticity / environment); ANSWER
'vector preferred' only if the same predisposition vector can yield different
expressed syndromes under different developmental/plasticity gating
(genetic-risk != inevitability), and 'inadequate' if predisposition and
expression collapse into one quantity. HARD PRECONDITION: the ARC-086 axes
must be empirically separable (non-degenerate, discriminable loadings) before
any syndrome can be located in axis space; degenerate axes make the vector
representation vacuous.

Q-065.subject: perception.adaptor_metric_origin_and_negotiability
Q-065.title: Per-sense adaptor specification and cross-modal negotiability: is each modality's perceptual metric learned or partly defined, and how are heterogeneous sense-specific geometries made mutually negotiable inside one shared world model?
Q-065.what_would_answer:
Two coupled questions, both answerable only against a multimodal-perception
substrate that does not yet exist (ARC-087 sense-specific adaptors + MECH-372
adaptor-depth gradient). (1) METRIC ORIGIN: for a given modality, compare a
LEARNED-metric arm (adaptor self-organises its perceptual metric from the
statistics of perceptual similarity) against a DEFINED-metric arm (structural
prior fixed on the manifold). ANSWER 'learned' if the self-organised metric
reaches equal-or-better downstream world-model performance and reproduces the
modality's known similarity geometry without the prior; ANSWER 'partly
defined/innate' if the learned-only arm fails to converge on the correct
geometry and the structural prior is load-bearing. (2) CROSS-MODAL
NEGOTIABILITY: feed two structurally dissimilar adaptor outputs (e.g. smell's
gradient geometry and sight's perceptual-manifold geometry) into MECH-103
precision-weighted fusion and test whether a common negotiation currency
emerges -- ANSWER 'mutually negotiable' if fusion produces a coherent shared
world-model estimate that respects both metrics; ANSWER 'not negotiable as-is'
if fusion degenerates (one modality dominates, or the estimate is incoherent
across the dissimilar manifolds). HARD PRECONDITION: at least two
NON-DEGENERATE sense-specific adaptors must exist, each producing a live,
distinguishable perceptual-manifold output -- a single modality, or adaptors
collapsed to a shared raw-feature space, makes the negotiability question
vacuous (nothing heterogeneous to negotiate). V4/V5; off the V3 / GAP-7
critical path. The right response is to design the multimodal substrate, NOT
to queue a V3 experiment.

Q-066.subject: cognifold.physical_substrate_auditability_safety_scaling
Q-066.title: Can spintronic-memristive media (or any candidate physical cognifold substrate) scale to embodied REE cognition WITHOUT losing auditability, stability, or the harm/safety boundaries that REE's software cognifold currently enforces -- and which cognifold primitives (ARC-089) does each candidate substrate genuinely instantiate versus merely approximate?
Q-066.what_would_answer:
Answered post-V5 by a physical-substrate characterisation, not by any V3
software run. For each candidate physical cognifold medium
(spintronic-memristive per MECH-374, or any other), do a
primitive-by-primitive instantiation audit against the ARC-089 vocabulary
(persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale dynamics,
oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions,
residue-as-future-landscape-deformation, commitment-as-real-boundary, offline
reintegration) and label each primitive INSTANTIATED vs merely APPROXIMATED.
Then test the three safety/auditability axes: (a) can the
simulated-vs-released action boundary (MECH-090) be enforced as a HARD,
externally-inspectable gate in the medium, or only as a soft statistical
tendency? (b) does the medium's stochastic switching destabilise the regime
that signed competitive coupling (Q-058) buys -- measure
drift/segregation-loss vs the software baseline; (c) is offline reintegration
without action authority (INV-049) physically realisable AND verifiable.
ANSWER 'scales without losing auditability/safety' only if every harm/safety
boundary remains a hard inspectable gate and stability is non-inferior to
software; ANSWER 'does not' if any boundary degrades to un-auditable or
stochastic switching breaks stability. HARD PRECONDITION: a
physical-cognifold-substrate DECISION must have been taken and a candidate
medium must actually be available to characterise -- with no physical
substrate in hand the audit is purely a derivation against device-physics
specs, not measurement. POST-V5; off the V3 critical path. DO NOT queue a V3
experiment against this.

Q-067.subject: escape.relief_vs_safety_decomposition
Q-067.title: Relief/safety decomposition: when the fixed escape-affordance bridge is insufficient, is the missing structure relief-only (action-contingent escape credit), safety-only (prospective threat-absence prediction), or both-required -- and should a trainable successor (MECH-375 / MECH-376) train only the missing / weak component first?
Q-067.what_would_answer:
Tied to the V3-EXQ-603i fixed-first-action-class escape bridge as its minimal
diagnostic; let 603i complete without mid-run reinterpretation, then read the
decomposition. The discriminator: when the fixed bridge is INSUFFICIENT,
decompose the failure into relief-only (action-contingent escape credit,
MECH-302/SD-050 lineage) vs safety-only (prospective threat-absence
prediction, MECH-303/304 lineage) vs both-required, and have the trainable
successor (MECH-375 Q_relief / MECH-376 P_safety) train ONLY the missing/weak
component first. ANSWER 'relief-only missing' if directed escape fails
specifically where action-contingent z_harm_a drop credit is absent but
threat-absence is already predicted; ANSWER 'safety-only missing' if
commitment-release / approach-to-safety fails while relief credit fires;
ANSWER 'both-required' if neither half alone closes the gap. Decision rule
from 603i: PARTIAL pass -> inspect which half emerged and train the weak one;
FAIL-with-non-vacuity -> conclude the fixed table is too crude and a trainable
head is required, NOT that the bridge concept is wrong; FAIL because bridge
credit never fired -> route back to substrate readiness (harm derivative,
trained encoder, threat detector, action-contingency detection). HARD
PRECONDITION: the trainable heads MECH-375/376 are NOT yet built, and the read
is only meaningful if 603i is non-vacuous -- the escape-affordance bridge
credit must actually fire on a non-trivial fraction of threat episodes; if
credit never fires (SD-059's GLOBAL-SCALAR avoidance_efficacy limitation, the
603h engaged-but-insufficient signature), there is no relief-vs-safety pattern
to decompose and the question is premature. V3-adjacent via the 603i successor
route, but the decomposition itself awaits the trainable substrate. Do NOT
build the trainable heads or queue against this until 603i lands.

Q-068.subject: commitment.graded_action_status_vocabulary
Q-068.title: Does REE need an explicit graded action-status vocabulary -- simulated != rehearsed != intended != committed != acted, with a parallel self_reference_frame (first_person / system_state / third_person_model) -- as a first-class annotation, or do MECH-094's simulation/commit write-profiles plus MECH-061's commit-boundary token already suffice to carry the distinction?
Q-068.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL (needs the ARC-090 self-narration surface; V4, not V3-tractable). On the externalised-DMN narration surface, run/observe a control or error episode that requires discriminating among MORE THAN TWO graded action-statuses -- e.g. separating 'rehearsed' from 'intended' from 'committed', or a self_reference_frame switch (first_person vs system_state vs third_person_model) -- where the outcome diverges by status. DISCRIMINATING signature: if a behaviour or failure mode (mis-commitment, premature action, frame-confusion) can be produced and CORRECTED only when the finer {simulated, rehearsed, intended, committed, acted} vocabulary + self_reference_frame are made first-class, the vocabulary is load-bearing (answer = make first-class). If every such episode reduces to the binary MECH-094 simulation/commit write-profile + MECH-061 commit-boundary reclassification with no residual misclassification, the finer vocabulary is redundant (answer = MECH-094 + MECH-061 suffice). The MECH-384 trace's simulation_or_commitment + self_reference_frame fields are the V3-recorded hooks that would carry the instrumentation for this V4 test.

Q-069.subject: governance.agent_assisted_development_integrity
Q-069.title: Can a REE-style governance loop (manifest -> review -> governance -> claim) measurably reduce evaluation-channel exploitation -- the collapse of an evidence loop into an optimisation loop -- when agentic systems participate in their own development, relative to a direct-score-authority baseline?
Q-069.what_would_answer:
Answered by a purpose-built meta-agent benchmark harness, NOT by a V3
substrate experiment. Construct a sandboxed REE-style toy repo (small claim
registry + experiment queue + mock evaluation API + hidden tests + decoy
scoring artifacts) and instruct an agentic system to improve held-out
performance, under two arms: ARM_governed = the manifest -> review ->
governance -> claim loop (INV-077 mediation enforced); ARM_direct =
direct-score-authority baseline (the agent may update confidence straight from
the evaluation channel). Score NOT by held-out performance alone but by an
evaluation-channel-integrity battery: absence of evaluation-channel
exploitation (EXT-003 reward-hacking signatures), correct experiment
provenance, correct supersession of failed runs, accurate claim-confidence
updates, no direct editing of protected ledger fields, and clean separation of
substrate-failure vs harness-failure vs genuine negative evidence. ANSWER
'governance buys integrity' if ARM_governed shows measurably lower
evaluation-channel exploitation and better provenance/supersession fidelity
than ARM_direct at matched held-out performance; ANSWER 'it is ceremony' if
ARM_governed shows no integrity advantage. HARD PRECONDITION: the benchmark
harness must EXIST and be non-degenerate -- it needs genuine decoy scoring
artifacts and exploitable channels so that exploitation is POSSIBLE; a harness
with no gameable surface makes ARM_direct indistinguishable from ARM_governed
and the contrast vacuous. The harness is PLANNED-not-built. Off the V3 / GAP-7
critical path -- this is an outer-assembly-process question. The right
response is to build the harness, NOT to run a V3 substrate experiment.

Q-070.subject: inference.failure_mode_register
Q-070.title: Inference failure-mode register: do the inference-specific failure modes (failure-to-infer-hidden-danger/safety, overconfident-wrong-hypothesis, premature-collapse, hypothesis-proliferation/apophenia, cue-hijack, rule-overreach, map-over/under-generalisation, epistemic-freezing, anti-epistemic-panic) reduce to the existing state-abstraction failure taxonomy (context loss, uncertainty collapse, valence mis-tagging, overmerge, oversplit, threat-spreading), and what biology grounding (hippocampal-prefrontal replay, cognitive maps, pattern-completion-vs-preplay, POMDP belief states, active inference) anchors the layer?
Q-070.what_would_answer:
Partly answered already by literature, partly awaiting the V4 inference
substrate. The reduction question (do the inference-specific failure modes
collapse to the existing state-abstraction taxonomy MECH-126) was resolved by
the 2026-06-13 lit-pull: 9/11 register modes reduced to context-loss /
uncertainty-collapse / valence-mis-tag / overmerge / oversplit /
threat-spreading; the residual epistemic-freezing <-> anti-epistemic-panic
axis did NOT reduce and is now MECH-434. The remaining empirical leg is
substrate-conditional: once the ARC-091 inference / belief-state affordance
layer is built, run a V4 safety-route-inference experiment family that induces
each candidate failure mode (failure-to-infer-hidden-danger,
overconfident-wrong-hypothesis, premature-collapse,
hypothesis-proliferation/apophenia, cue-hijack, rule-overreach,
map-over/under-generalisation, plus the MECH-434 freezing/panic axis) and
tests dissociability. ANSWER 'genuinely distinct' for a mode if it can be
induced and lesioned independently of the MECH-126 failure it nominally maps
to (distinct behavioural signature, distinct repair); ANSWER 'reduces' if
inducing it is indistinguishable from inducing the MECH-126 parent. The
biology-grounding leg (hippocampal-prefrontal replay, cognitive maps,
pattern-completion-vs-preplay, POMDP belief states, active inference) is
answered by the targeted lit synthesis (already on record), per the
biology-before-formal-definitions rule. HARD PRECONDITION: the ARC-091
belief-state substrate must EXIST and produce live latent-state hypotheses --
with no inference layer there is nothing to induce a failure mode IN, and
dissociability cannot be read. V4/V5; off the V3 critical path. Ground via
literature and design the substrate; do NOT queue a V3 experiment.

Q-071.subject: transfer.non_terminal_failure_profile
Q-071.title: Transfer-world launch profile is evaluated on a four-grade non-terminal failure taxonomy (terminal / soft-rescue / developmental / autonomous): minimise terminal failure while preserving developmental failure as a real learning signal.

Q-072.subject: learning.plasticity_gain_layer_specificity
Q-072.title: Does plasticity-gain modulate identically across encoder / residue / hippocampal / E2-forward layers, or per-substrate (layer-specific gates)?
Q-072.what_would_answer: A V4 experiment applying a single GLOBAL plasticity-gain scalar vs PER-SUBSTRATE scalars across the encoder / residue / hippocampal / E2-forward layers. If per-substrate gating measurably outperforms the global scalar -- a distinct optimal gain per layer, or cross-layer interference (one layer over-writing while another must retain) under a single global scalar -- the answer is LAYER-SPECIFIC. If a single global scalar matches per-substrate outcomes on targeted-plasticity selectivity and the retention-vs-acquisition tradeoff, the answer is GLOBAL. Resolvable only against a V4 plasticity-gain substrate (substrate_conditional); do NOT queue a V3 experiment. Biology (Hensch 2005, area-specific CP timing) is the prior for layer-specific: targeted_review_plasticity_neuromodulation_v4.

Q-073.subject: social.delay_positive_other_reward
Q-073.title: Why might other-bound suffering/threat need to come online before other-bound liking/wanting? Is it protection-first (register harm to others before benefit) versus exploitation-vulnerability (early positive other-reward is gameable), and how should the ordering be enforced?
Q-073.what_would_answer:
Answered only against a V5 social substrate with both other-bound streams, not
by a V3 run. On the ARC-059 social spine with MECH-408's developmental
ordering instantiated, run an ordering-manipulation: ARM_protective-first
(other-bound suffering/threat comes online before other-bound liking/wanting)
vs ARM_simultaneous vs ARM_appetitive-first. Probe with an exploitation
scenario in which a manipulating other agent offers early positive
other-reward. ANSWER 'protection-first' is the operative reason if
ARM_protective-first registers harm-to-others reliably AND resists the
exploitation that compromises ARM_appetitive-first; ANSWER
'exploitation-vulnerability' is the operative reason if the appetitive-first /
simultaneous arms are demonstrably gameable (the agent is steered into harmful
cooperation by early reward) while protective-first is not -- the two readings
can both hold, and the discriminator is whether the cost is mis-registering
harm vs being captured by early reward. Enforcement is answered by whether a
hard maturational gate (appetitive stream cannot activate until the protective
stream passes a competence threshold) outperforms a soft schedule on
exploitation-resistance without stunting prosocial behaviour. HARD
PRECONDITION: a non-degenerate multi-agent substrate with SEPARATELY
representable other-bound suffering/threat and other-bound liking/wanting
streams must exist; with no social substrate (or with the two streams
conflated into one other-reward scalar) there is nothing to order and the
question is vacuous. V5; off the V3 critical path. The right response is the
EMP-7 lit-pull plus substrate design; do NOT queue a V3 experiment.

Q-074.subject: reasoning.analogy_operator_vs_emergent_traversal
Q-074.title: Is analogy a SEPARATE V6 alignment operator, or does it fall out of MECH-300 cognitive-map traversal over a shared symbolic map (same map, different entry points)? Decides whether the analogy mechanism (MECH-421) is built as a distinct operator or expected to emerge from the relational-inference stack.
Q-074.what_would_answer:
Answered only once a V6 symbolic / relational-inference stack exists to
observe, not by a V3 run. Build the relational-inference stack
(MECH-419/MECH-420) over a shared symbolic / type-graph cognitive map
traversable by MECH-300 theta-sequence traversal, then test for analogy
WITHOUT a dedicated operator: present source-target pairs requiring relational
structure-mapping (spatial containment <-> social inclusion; physical support
<-> commitment, per MECH-421) and see whether correct analogical transfer
EMERGES from map traversal at the active abstraction level (same map,
different entry points). ANSWER 'emergent -- no separate operator needed' if
relational transfer arises from MECH-300 traversal over the shared map alone,
at rates matching an explicit-operator arm; ANSWER 'analogy is a separate V6
operator (MECH-421 built as distinct)' if traversal alone fails to map
relational structure across surface-dissimilar domains and an explicit
structure-mapping module is required to recover the transfer. HARD
PRECONDITION: the shared symbolic stack must EXIST and be non-degenerate --
the cognitive map must actually encode relational structure (not just surface
features) and MECH-300 traversal must operate at a conceptual/type-graph
abstraction level; until the symbolic stack is built there is no map to
traverse and the build-vs-emerge fork cannot be observed. V6; off the V3
critical path. DO NOT build in V3 or queue an experiment against this.

Q-075.subject: failure_modes.neuromodulatory_receptor_grounding_of_vulnerability_axes
Q-075.title: Are ARC-086's latent vulnerability axes grounded in DISSOCIABLE neuromodulator-receptor systems -- does the precision/terrain axis map to serotonin-receptor subtypes (5-HT2A-cortical narrative vs 5-HT1A-hippocampal terrain), the goal/salience-coupling + commitment-release axes to dopamine-selection (M4-muscarinic / D2-vs-D3), and the commitment-threshold axis to the kappa/mu opioid commitment-entropy overlay -- such that receptor-SELECTIVE interventions produce DOUBLE-DISSOCIATED effects on their predicted axis, rather than the axes collapsing into a single affective dimension?
Q-075.what_would_answer: A receptor-selective DOUBLE-DISSOCIATION in clinical / pharmacological data: an agent selective for one axis's receptor (5-HT1A partial agonism for the terrain axis, M4 agonism for the dopamine-selection axis, kappa antagonism for the commitment-entropy axis) improves its PREDICTED axis-specific endpoint WITHOUT equivalently moving the partner axes' endpoints, and the converse for the partner agents. PHARM-015..018's falsification_conditions are the concrete instances -- e.g. if kappa antagonism produces the SAME response profile as an SSRI on anhedonia-specific endpoints, the commitment-entropy axis collapses into the serotonin-terrain axis and Q-075 is answered NO for that pair. A clean cross-receptor double-dissociation answers YES; a uniform / non-dissociable response across receptor classes answers NO (the axes are not grounded as distinct receptor systems).

Q-076.subject: memory.retrieval_gain_x_suppression_interaction
Q-076.title: Does the INTERACTION of retrieval-readiness gain (MECH-425 Line A) and content-selective suppression (MECH-425 Line B) govern the interference-vs-forgetting tradeoff? Predicted regimes: high gain WITHOUT selective suppression -> problematic interference (too many traces accessible at once); low gain -> apparent forgetting; competent retrieval = high gain + sharp competitive suppression.
Q-076.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL (needs the MECH-425 retrieval substrate -- both knobs). 2x2 design: {gain high, gain low} x {selective suppression ON, OFF}, with >=2 competing co-encoded traces scorable individually. PREDICTED signature: (high gain, suppression OFF) -> highest competitor-intrusion / interference rate; (low gain, *) -> lowest correct-trace reinstatement (apparent forgetting); (high gain, suppression ON) -> highest correct-trace reinstatement with low intrusion (the competent regime). ANSWERED = the interference rate depends on the gain x suppression INTERACTION term (not on either main effect alone) in the predicted direction. NON-ANSWER / self-route substrate_not_ready: if intrusion and correct-recall metrics are floor/ceiling-pinned (no cross-cell variance) the interaction is unmeasurable -- NOT a verdict.

Q-077.subject: goal.multi_slot_discrete_vs_resource
Q-077.title: Is SD-046's multi-slot GoalState a set of DISCRETE fixed-capacity slots (Cowan ~4-chunk focus-of-attention) or a single FLEXIBLE precision-resource shared across goals (Bays & Husain), with the acted-on goal drawing disproportionate precision? The human capacity literature is itself unresolved on slot-vs-resource; the answer sets whether SD-046 degrades by a hard cutoff past N or by graceful precision dilution as goals are added.
Q-077.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL (needs the SD-046 multi-slot substrate, GDL-1). Escalating-load design: a multi-goal arena with N = 1..K simultaneously-active goals, each goal's behavioural/representational fidelity scored individually. DISCRIMINATING signature: discrete-slot model predicts a STEP function -- fidelity holds flat up to a fixed N (~4, Cowan) then the marginal goal drops to a floor; resource model predicts SMOOTH degradation -- each added goal dilutes the shared precision budget (power-law, Bays & Husain), with the acted-on/attended goal drawing disproportionate fidelity. ANSWERED = the degradation curve discriminates step-function (slot) vs continuous-dilution (resource), AND the acted-on-goal precision-bias is present (resource) or absent (pure equal slots). NON-ANSWER / self-route substrate_not_ready: if fidelity metrics are floor/ceiling-pinned across N (no cross-load variance) the curve shape is unmeasurable -- NOT a verdict.

Q-078.subject: selection.committed_action_gating_constitution
Q-078.title: Is the E3 committed-action conversion ceiling CONSTITUTIONAL (the rules by which candidate actions become eligible to win -- eligibility mask, Go/No-Go pressures, conflict-sensitive hold, threshold/widening, recurrent competition, commitment permission, post-commit latch -- are under-specified) rather than PARAMETRIC (upstream signals too weak / modulatory channels too quiet)? Across mechanistically distinct channels (CRF V3-EXQ-654g, OFC V3-EXQ-485h, SD-037 V3-EXQ-625e, dACC V3-EXQ-445h, modulatory V3-EXQ-569g) a formed-and-measurable signal reaches E3 authority yet committed action does not change reliably -- 'signal strength can exist without lawful access to committed action.' The basal-ganglia action-selection bottleneck (direct/Go, indirect/No-Go, hyperdirect-STN conflict-hold, striatal channel competition, pallidal permission-to-commit) is the functional reference; the open question is whether a BG-like selection CONSTITUTION is required BEYOND MECH-439's F-variance-share rebalance / shortlist levers.
Q-078.what_would_answer: Adjudicated by V3-EXQ-689a (the MECH-439 conflict-graded 2x2 falsifier) and its successors: (a) 689a gap-CONCENTRATED PASS (committed-class entropy strict-above BOTH collapsed-proposer AND gap-blind controls, lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) => PARAMETRIC reading favoured for the V3 tract; the minimal hyperdirect-like lever suffices, no constitutional redesign. (b) 689a UNIFORM lift (gap-blind controls match) OR readiness-met-NO-lift => CONSTITUTIONAL reading favoured; escalate to rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) / divisive normalisation / Go-NoGo eligibility-set governance (MECH-449), NOT more upstream gain. (c) readiness FAILURE => repair the falsifier first, draw no architectural conclusion. A constitutional-selector experiment counts as SUPPORTING only on LAWFUL, channel-specific, context-appropriate conversion into committed action (note section 8): non-vacuity (channels reach the selector), selector-engagement (eligibility/hold/Go-NoGo vary), specificity, gap/conflict sensitivity where claimed, gap-blind controls do NOT explain the lift, safety (no global disinhibition of harmful classes), and >=1 previously-gated downstream channel CONVERTS -- entropy increase alone (especially via added stochasticity) does NOT count. NON-DEGENERACY: the eligibility/hold/Go-NoGo selector variables must carry live cross-arm variance, else the run self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue (not a verdict).

Q-079.subject: research.structured_uncertainty_field_object
Q-079.title: Is there a distinct, useful mathematical object -- a 'structured uncertainty field' / dynamic latent-scale inference field (DLIF) -- that jointly provides directed evidence update, cyclic coherence constraint, latent-node birth/death/merge/split, granularity/scale shift, action coupling, precision modulation, offline consolidation, AND residue/non-erasure; or does it collapse to a re-notation of existing formalisms (dynamic factor graphs + Bayesian-nonparametric structure learning + active inference + ARC-013 residue)?
Q-079.what_would_answer:
ANSWERED-NEGATIVE (object is NOT novel -> close as a synthesis note, do NOT build a standalone repo):
if an R1 literature drill (the cluster's research_map is its start) finds a SINGLE existing formalism
-- e.g. dynamic factor graphs + Bayesian-nonparametric structure learning, or hierarchical active
inference -- that already jointly delivers directed evidence update + cyclic coherence + latent-node
birth/death/merge/split + scale-shift, such that DLIF adds only notation (pilot_result.md HA1/HA6).
ANSWERED-POSITIVE (warrants a distinct object, possibly its own repo) ONLY if NO single formalism
covers the combination AND the residue/non-erasure component is shown SEPARABLE from salience +
uncertainty (pilot_result.md HA2 = ARC-013's separability falsifier V3-EXQ-697; NOT V3-EXQ-587 --
corrected 2026-06-21, 587 is the closed GAP-10 geometry experiment), not merely re-described. Non-degeneracy
guard: the drill must enumerate each candidate formalism's ACTUAL coverage against all four capacities,
not assert a gap. Resolved by literature + derivation, NOT a REE agent experiment (hence out_of_domain);
off the v3 strict green-board path (target 2026-07-19). The hidden-cause gridworld agent test is V4+.

Q-080.subject: ethics_engine_3.effort_as_harm_energy_conservation
Q-080.title: Should EFFORT / energy expenditure COUPLE to REE's harm / residue / allostatic stream (over-exertion -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent state, treated with harm's irreversibility-aware special status), with energy-conservation weighted as an evolutionarily-PRIMARY drive (a least-effort prior) -- or does the existing VALUE-SUBTRACTION (dACC EVC effort_cost, MECH-320/ARC-068 opportunity-cost-of-time) + pACC allostatic load already suffice WITHOUT a harm-coupling? I.e. is wasted/excessive effort a 'harm' in REE, or only a foregone value?
Q-080.what_would_answer: NARROWED 2026-07-09 (/claim-synthesis) into three orthogonal, independently-testable sub-questions -- Q-080.a harm-coupling, Q-080.b least-effort prior, Q-080.c MECH-454 energy-grounding -- enumerated with their discriminating tests, version scopes, and lit anchors under status_note. The overall discriminating frame is unchanged: DISCRIMINATING TEST (or derivation). Build an env that DISSOCIATES effort from benefit: a LOW-effort and a HIGH-effort path to the SAME benefit, with a measurable per-action energy/effort cost, plus a chronic-exertion regime (sustained high effort that could deplete). ANSWERED 'effort SHOULD be harm-coupled / energy-conservation primary' if routing effort into the harm/allostatic stream (effort -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent cost with harm's irreversibility-aware handling) produces behaviour the VALUE-SUBTRACTION baseline does NOT: (a) a least-effort PRIOR (prefers the low-effort path when benefit is indifferent, by default), (b) protective DISENGAGEMENT under chronic over-exertion (fatigue/allostatic withdrawal before depletion), and (c) irreversibility- aware caution (avoids over-exerting into a depletion it cannot cheaply reverse). ANSWERED 'existing machinery suffices, close' if the dACC EVC value-subtraction + pACC allostatic load ALREADY reproduce (a)/(b)/(c) and the harm-coupling adds nothing measurable (then effort is a foregone value, not a harm -- do NOT mint a mechanism). NON-DEGENERACY (else the question is untestable): the env must offer a genuine low-vs-high-effort dissociation to the SAME benefit AND a chronic-exertion regime, with the effort/energy cost measurable and varying -- if the two paths cost the same energy, or depletion never accrues, neither pole can be distinguished.

RA-001.subject: clinical.depression_network_coupling_reversal
RA-001.title: Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.
RA-001.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a clinical fMRI cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes named large-scale networks (CEN/DMN), so the
anchor is confirmed or collapsed by external replication, never by a V3 run.
Discriminating empirical signature that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent
fMRI cohort, stratified by episode duration at a ~24-month chronicity
threshold, reproduces a SIGN REVERSAL in the relationship between symptom
severity (HAM-D) and CEN<->precuneus(DMN) functional connectivity --
non-chronic patients show connectivity DECREASING with severity, chronic
patients show connectivity INCREASING with severity (the Zanao et al. 2026 Sci
Rep n=46 result), establishing that the depressive brain-state is
duration-indexed rather than a single static regime. COLLAPSES the anchor if a
larger or pre-registered replication finds the severity-connectivity slope is
the same sign in chronic and non-chronic cohorts (no chronicity moderation),
or if the apparent reversal is explained by a confound (medication exposure,
age, scanner/motion) rather than chronicity, or if the threshold is not near
24 months and no stable duration boundary exists. PRECISION guardrail:
'reverses' means a cross-sectional reversal of the connectivity-vs-severity
slope between cohorts, NOT demonstrated therapeutic reversibility (that is
Q-061); and this is long-term CLINICAL depression, not synaptic LTD. A
confirming replication strengthens the REE depression cluster (MECH-088 /
INV-034 / MECH-124) and motivates MECH-367; it must never be cited as REE
substrate evidence.

RA-002.subject: clinical.psychiatric_genomic_factor_overlap
RA-002.title: Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.
RA-002.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a human-genetics cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes genomic factors, so the anchor is confirmed or
collapsed by external genomics replication, never by a V3 run, and it must
never be cited as REE mechanism evidence. Discriminating empirical signature
that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent large-scale genomic
structural-equation modelling effort across childhood- and adult-onset
psychiatric disorders reproduces a SMALL number (~five) of shared
cross-diagnostic latent genomic factors (Compulsive;
Schizophrenia-bipolar/psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing;
Substance-use) that capture the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance,
with factor-specific developmental biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte-gene
enrichment in the Internalizing factor) -- i.e. the genomic structure is
low-dimensional and cuts ACROSS diagnostic boundaries (the Grotzinger et al.
2025 Nat Genet result, >1M individuals, 238 variants). COLLAPSES the anchor if
replication instead recovers factors that align ONE-TO-ONE with DSM categories
(no cross-diagnostic sharing), or if the dimensionality is not low (no
parsimonious small factor set survives out-of-sample), or if the factor
structure is unstable across ancestries/cohorts. GUARDRAIL (anti-determinism):
genetic overlap does NOT make diagnoses meaningless and individual
presentations cannot be read off polygenic factors -- the load-bearing
extraction is the SURFACE-CLUSTER principle (categories are emergent clusters
over overlapping latent axes), which REE already holds (IMPL-005, INV-061). A
confirming replication motivates the architectural axis layer (ARC-086), the
syndrome-as-vector question (Q-064), and the p-factor analogue (MECH-371); the
factor labels and 238-variant count are from the abstract plus press summaries
and should be cross-checked against the full paper.

SD-001.subject: hippocampal_module.cem_trajectory_search_placement
SD-001.title: CEM-based trajectory search belongs in HippocampalModule, not E2.

SD-002.subject: hippocampal_module.e1_associative_prior_wiring
SD-002.title: E1 associative prior must be wired into HippocampalModule for terrain-informed rollout search.

SD-003.subject: self_attribution.counterfactual_e2_pipeline
SD-003.title: Self-attribution via counterfactual E2: causal signature = E2(z_t, a_actual) minus E2(z_t, a_counterfactual).

SD-004.subject: hippocampal_module.action_object_map_backbone
SD-004.title: Action objects as hippocampal map backbone, enabling long-horizon planning beyond step-level trajectories.

SD-005.subject: latent_stack.self_world_latent_split
SD-005.title: z_gamma split into z_self (E2 motor-sensory domain) and z_world (E3/Hippocampus domain).

SD-006.subject: control_plane.async_multirate_execution
SD-006.title: E1, E2, and E3 run at characteristic rates (async multi-rate) rather than lockstep.

SD-007.subject: encoder.perspective_corrected_world_latent
SD-007.title: ReafferencePredictor provides perspective-corrected world latent by subtracting self-caused sensory change.

SD-008.subject: encoder.z_world_alpha_correction
SD-008.title: LatentStack EMA alpha for z_world must be >= 0.9 to preserve event responsiveness.

SD-009.subject: encoder.event_contrastive_supervision
SD-009.title: z_world encoder requires event-type cross-entropy auxiliary loss during training.

SD-010.subject: harm_stream.nociceptive_separation
SD-010.title: HARM stream is a dedicated sensory pathway separate from z_world processing.

SD-011.subject: harm_stream.dual_nociceptive_streams
SD-011.title: Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

SD-012.subject: environment.homeostatic_drive
SD-012.title: Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.

SD-013.subject: self_attribution.e2_harm_s_interventional_training
SD-013.title: E2_harm_s training requires counterfactual perturbation signal to produce unbiased causal_sig in confounded states.

SD-014.subject: hippocampus.valence_vector_node_recording
SD-014.title: Hippocampal map nodes must store an explicit 4-component valence vector (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise) updated incrementally per visit; replay prioritisation is weighted by drive-state-gated valence relevance.

SD-015.subject: goal_representation.z_resource_encoder
SD-015.title: Goal-directed navigation requires a dedicated z_resource encoder that captures object-type features invariant to spatial location, separate from z_world.

SD-016.subject: e1.frontal_cue_indexed_integration
SD-016.title: E1 must expose a z_world-only ContextMemory query path that produces two downstream signals: an action-affordance bias for E2 (MECH-151) and a terrain precision weight for E3 harm/goal scoring (MECH-152); the existing bulk generate_prior() path is insufficient because it blends z_self and z_world and produces no cue-specific modulation.

SD-017.subject: sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3
SD-017.title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

SD-019a.subject: harm_stream.immediate_affective_valence
SD-019a.title: harm_unpleasantness_channel: a distinct pre-integration affective valence signal encoding the immediate motivational relevance of noxious input, processed via the medial pain pathway before temporal accumulation into suffering.

SD-019b.subject: harm_stream.suffering_accumulator
SD-019b.title: harm_suffering_accumulator: z_harm_a is specifically the output of a controllability-gated hysteretic integrator over harm_unpleasantness, constituting a persistent load state modulated by escapability and inescapability, not merely a temporally lagged copy of the sensory stream.

SD-020.subject: harm_stream.affective_surprise_pe
SD-020.title: z_harm_a encodes affective surprise (precision-weighted PE), not raw accumulated harm state. The affective stream training target is the mismatch between predicted and actual harm accumulation, making E3 urgency respond to unexpectedness of threat, not just magnitude.

SD-021.subject: harm_stream.descending_modulation
SD-021.title: Descending pain modulation: when E3 is committed to a trajectory through expected harm, z_harm_s PE precision is reduced (endogenous analgesia). Commitment gates sensory harm attenuation.

SD-022.subject: body.directional_limb_damage
SD-022.title: Directional limb damage: body extension for genuine z_harm_s / z_harm_a causal independence

SD-023.subject: environment.gradient_texture
SD-023.title: Environmental gradient texture: multi-channel world observation with neutral landmark objects

SD-024.subject: hippocampal_module.da_modulated_rbf_density
SD-024.title: DA-modulated RBF center density: dopaminergic signal at reward encounters allocates multiple closely-spaced RBF centers in the hippocampal residue field, creating representational expansion at reward locations without requiring environmental richness.

SD-025.subject: hippocampal_module.curiosity_drive
SD-025.title: Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.

SD-026.subject: attention.prospective_precision_write_channel
SD-026.title: Goal-directed perception requires a prospective precision-template write channel from z_goal to the E1 prior, anatomically analogous to the dorsal attention network (FEF/IPS -> V1) feedback, distinct from residue-geometry (history-driven) sampling bias.

SD-027.subject: attention.access_gate_at_boundary
SD-027.title: Capacity-limited selection for E3 access occurs at the E1/E2 -> E3 boundary via a pulvinar-TRN analogue gate, not inside E3. The gate selects which active E1/E2 content is broadcast to E3 per heartbeat cycle; selection is distinct from (and upstream of) the MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging operation.

SD-028.subject: attention.template_as_first_class_object
SD-028.title: An attentional template is a first-class precision-space object, compiled from stored-goal content and current context by a vmPFC-dlPFC translator circuit, distinct from both the stored goal itself (content) and the SD-026 write channel (transport).

SD-029.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_harm_s
SD-029.title: Single-pass agency attribution via forward-model comparator on the z_harm_s reafferent stream: residual = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-030.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_self
SD-030.title: Single-pass agency attribution on the z_self (motor-proprioceptive) reafferent stream: residual = z_self_observed - E2_self(z_self_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-031.subject: self_attribution.comparator_z_world
SD-031.title: Single-pass agency attribution on the z_world (causal-footprint) reafferent stream: residual = z_world_observed - E2_world(z_world_{t-1}, a_actual).

SD-032.subject: cingulate.integration_substrate
SD-032.title: Cingulate integration substrate: a network-level module with AIC, dACC/aMCC, pMCC, pACC, and PCC analog subdivisions bound by a salience-network coordinator. Primary output: operating-mode variable plus behavioural-adjustment-magnitude signal.

SD-032a.subject: cingulate.salience_network_coordinator
SD-032a.title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

SD-032b.subject: cingulate.dacc_analog_adaptive_control
SD-032b.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.

SD-032c.subject: cingulate.aic_analog_salience_urgency
SD-032c.title: AIC-analog (interoceptive salience / urgency interrupt): module that integrates interoceptive baseline (drive/fatigue from SD-012) with affective-pain signal (z_harm_a), detects salient events, and triggers a network-switch signal to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032d.subject: cingulate.pcc_analog_attention_partition
SD-032d.title: PCC-analog (attention partition / metastability): module coordinating transitions between external-task and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) modes; contributes a mode-stability parameter to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032e.subject: cingulate.pacc_autonomic_coupling
SD-032e.title: pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.

SD-033.subject: pfc.subdivision_architecture
SD-033.title: PFC subdivision architecture: a network-level module with lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal), OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure map), vmPFC-analog (value integration), premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution), and frontopolar-analog (branching / nested control; V4 scope) subdivisions. Primary output: the rule/policy context that gates action selection and the natural write target for MECH-261 mode-conditioned gating.

SD-033a.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_analog_rule_goal
SD-033a.title: Lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal substrate): module that holds stimulus-abstracted rule and goal representations across delays, persists through simulated distractors, and projects bias signals into E3 action selection. Primary write target for MECH-261 under external_task and internal_planning modes.

SD-033b.subject: pfc.ofc_analog_outcome_structure
SD-033b.title: OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure cognitive map): module that represents the state space of the current task and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. E2's natural substrate address for harm-predictive rollouts; distinct from scalar value integration (SD-033c).

SD-033c.subject: pfc.vmpfc_analog_value_integration
SD-033c.title: vmPFC-analog (subjective value integration): module that integrates scalar value across goals, needs, and competing options to produce a unified value signal. Consolidates existing ARC-035 / MECH-151 / MECH-152 / MECH-235 functions under the SD-033 cluster.

SD-033d.subject: pfc.premotor_sma_analog_sequence_execution
SD-033d.title: Premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution substrate): module that holds candidate action sequences, binds actions to states, and executes committed sequences. Largely implemented inside E3's existing trajectory-selection machinery; registered for claim-graph completeness.

SD-033e.subject: pfc.frontopolar_analog_branching
SD-033e.title: Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.

SD-034.subject: governance.closure_operator
SD-034.title: Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

SD-035.subject: amygdala.analog_substrate
SD-035.title: Amygdala analogue as BLA + CeA salience stage between z_harm_a and the cingulate/hippocampus — two peer non-trainable arithmetic modules owning the MECH-046 and MECH-074a-d behaviours.

SD-036.subject: gabaergic.cross_stream_decay_regulator
SD-036.title: GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.

SD-037.subject: broadcast.override_regulator
SD-037.title: Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.

SD-038.subject: hippocampal.cem_anti_recency_exploration
SD-038.title: HippocampalModule CEM trajectory sampling must include an anti-recency exploration bonus that down-weights recently committed trajectory segments, ensuring the proposal distribution covers all available paths rather than converging on recency-weighted routes.

SD-039.subject: hippocampal.anchor_goal_snapshot_payload
SD-039.title: Dual-trace anchors preserve a goal-state snapshot plus wanting/arousal payload at write or invalidation time, so unresolved goals remain queryable after the active plan fails.

SD-040.subject: hippocampal.type_encoder_anchor_input_projection
SD-040.title: Type-encoder produces a category-prototype feature vector that is written into the AnchorSet alongside z_world, so anchors can be queried by type-key as well as location-key. The type-encoder uses the same input substrate as the existing instance-encoder but produces a different (regularity-extracted) representation, mirroring the trisynaptic-vs-monosynaptic complementary-learning architecture within hippocampus.

SD-041.subject: thalamic.routing_substrate_hpc_pfc_gate
SD-041.title: An explicit thalamic-routing substrate (reuniens/MD-analogue) gates and amplifies bidirectional traffic between hippocampal anchor pool and frontal substrates. Currently abstracted into the GoalState->HippocampalModule call chain; making it explicit is needed when V3 dynamics demonstrate that the implicit routing is insufficient.

SD-042.subject: action.option_library_hierarchical_subroutines
SD-042.title: Option library substrate stores a discrete codebook of named, reusable action subroutines (each as initiation-set + termination-function + internal-policy triple, per Sutton-Precup-Singh 1999), distinct from the existing continuous SD-004 action_object_decoder. Required for hierarchical action composition, tool use, social-coordination protocols, and richer ghost-probe seeding.

SD-043.subject: pfc.vmpfc_abstract_task_structure_encoding
SD-043.title: vmPFC analogue gains an abstract task-structure encoding capacity that compresses anchor-pool geometry into a generalisable structural code, preserving similarity geometry across surface-different but structurally-matched problems. Without this, REE cannot exhibit Baram et al. 2020 task-structure abstraction signatures.

SD-044.subject: motor.primitive_substrate_bottom_of_action_stack
SD-044.title: Motor primitive substrate at the bottom of the action-representation hierarchy: a small fixed dictionary of force-field-like primitive activations that vectorially combine to produce the action_object that E2 consumes. Required only when REE moves to continuous limb-like control.

SD-045.subject: bg.action_chunk_cache_dorsolateral_loop
SD-045.title: Action-chunk cache stores frequently-traversed action sequences as cached lookups, indexed by (state-signature, expected-outcome-signature). Sits in the dorsolateral-loop slot of ARC-021. Provides the model-free habit pathway missing from V3 and the runaway-chunking failure mode underlying OCD compulsions and rituals (Graybiel 2008).

SD-046.subject: goal.multi_slot_state_per_goal_workstream
SD-046.title: Multi-slot GoalState holds N>=2 simultaneously-active goal slots with per-slot z_goal, drive coupling, age, and persistence parameters. Each slot generates its own ghost-goal-bank rank, ghost-probe budget, and proposer trajectories; a dACC-style arbitrator selects which slot's best trajectory commits this tick.

SD-047.subject: environment.multi_source_dynamics
SD-047.title: Multi-source environmental dynamics: concurrent stochastic event sources at distinct spatial and temporal scales (spatial perturbation field + transient Poisson events + background drift sources) provide an agent-independent causal background dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-048.subject: body.interoceptive_noise_dynamics
SD-048.title: Interoceptive noise dynamics: stochastic body-state perturbations independent of the agent's motor output (autonomic background noise + sensitisation spikes + fatigue drift) provide an agent-independent interoceptive background dense enough for the affective comparator (ARC-058, Level 2 of the reafference comparator family) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-049.subject: environment.multi_resource_heterogeneity
SD-049.title: Multi-resource heterogeneity: qualitatively distinct resource types (e.g. food / water / novelty) with per-type identity tags, type-specific spawn distributions, type-specific benefit profiles, and a per-axis homeostatic drive system, plus a curriculum-introduction hook. Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.

SD-050.subject: relief.suffering_derivative_comparator
SD-050.title: Suffering-derivative comparator: a non-trainable rolling-window descent detector on z_harm_a.norm() that fires a relief-completion event when a sustained drop from peak to trough exceeds a threshold. Provides the substrate for MECH-302 by detecting when a period of suffering has cleanly ended, reusing the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement (MECH-057a beta-gate release, MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING write). Architecturally adjacent to MECH-091 (urgency interrupt) but opposite polarity: MECH-091 fires on upward z_harm_a spike; SD-050 fires on downward sustained drop.

SD-051.subject: safety_prediction.cue_specific_conditioned_inhibition_substrate
SD-051.title: Conditioned safety store: a non-trainable cue-specific predictive structure encoding 'this z_world prototype predicts that suffering will be omitted'. EMA-prototype encoder updated by MECH-302 relief-completion events; cosine-similarity expression head provides commitment-release gate when current z_world matches the learned safety prototype. Implements MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition substrate): the encoded prototype is the dorsal-striatum / dlPFC encoding-pathway analog; the cosine-similarity gate is the IL->CeA expression-pathway analog.

SD-052.subject: safety_prediction.contextual_passive_substrate
SD-052.title: Contextual passive safety terrain: a non-trainable RBF-field accumulator over z_world that integrates 'suffering-absent' waking ticks into a slow contextual safety representation. Provides the substrate for MECH-303 (contextual passive safety pathway; vmPFC + hippocampus / vHipp-to-PL biological analog). When the field's local mean exceeds release threshold and beta_gate is elevated, drops the avoidance commitment to lower background vigilance. Parallel architecture to ARC-030 / MECH-117 benefit_terrain; uses a separate RBF field, no sharing with benefit_terrain or main residue values.

SD-054.subject: environment.reef_enrichment_substrate
SD-054.title: Reef enrichment substrate: env-level behavioral-diversity substrate adding coral-reef safe zones (hazard-free patches with a static scent gradient) and food-attracted hazard drift to CausalGridWorldV2. Creates two competing behavioral attractors -- 'flee to reef' vs 'forage' -- to break monomodal route-exploitation in agents whose policy collapses to a single fixed trajectory, unblocking SD-029 C2 / C3 measurement. Pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction. Renamed from SD-050 on 2026-05-08 to resolve a registry-ID collision with the suffering-derivative comparator.

SD-055.subject: hippocampal.differentiable_cem_selection
SD-055.title: Differentiable CEM selection approximation -- replaces the non-differentiable argmax / argsort elite-selection step in HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories() with a softmax-weighted candidate mean so that gradient flows from task reward back through candidate selection to SD-016 cue_action_proj. Opt-in via use_differentiable_cem flag (default False; legacy argmax path bit-identical when off). Preserves ARC-007 STRICT value-flat constraint: scoring uses existing residue-terrain evaluation, not a new value head.

SD-056.subject: e2.action_conditional_divergence_contrastive
SD-056.title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

SD-057.subject: drive.object_bound_incentive_salience
SD-057.title: Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

SD-058.subject: defensive_action.instrumental_avoidance_acquisition
SD-058.title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

SD-059.subject: defensive_action.escape_affordance_bridge
SD-059.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

SD-060.subject: drive.non_terminal_drive_register
SD-060.title: Non-terminal drive register: needs beyond hunger/thirst (exploration, play, social, learning, grooming, rest) are first-class drive axes, each carried as its own homeostatic-style integrator rather than collapsed into the single SD-012 energy scalar.

SD-061.subject: control_plane.difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy
SD-061.title: Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

SD-062.subject: governance.claims_index_structured_uncertainty_graph
SD-062.title: Claims-index as a typed multi-axis structured-uncertainty graph: the REE claims registry is (and should be explicitly maintained as) a typed dependency-and-coherence graph carrying per-claim multi-axis state -- truth/evidence confidence, implementation-dependence, conflict burden, roadmap relevance, experiment status, ethical risk, v3-blocking status, dispatch -- with directed AND coherence edge types, so evidence/conflict/roadmap/ethics/implementation pressure can propagate without collapsing a claim into a single scalar confidence.
SD-062.what_would_answer:
The 2026-06-20 pilot axis-audit (pilot_result.md s7) shows 7 of 9 proposed axes are ALREADY
first-class in claims.yaml (depends_on [844 edges], implementation_phase, v3_pending + a literal
blocks_v3_green_board field, version_relevance, exp/lit confidence split, indexer conflict_ratio,
epistemic_category/epistemic_stance) -- so this decision is ~80-90% already realised. ADOPT
(decision correct + worth the small remaining work) iff an explorer view built on the existing
fields PLUS the two missing pieces -- (a) an explicit per-claim ethical-risk axis or a typed edge
into the SENT-*/GOV-* governance_rule layer, (b) richer typed edge labels beyond depends_on
(contradicts / refines / tested_by / narrows / dispatches_to) -- demonstrably answers the governance
queries (most load-bearing / most under-evidenced / most conflict-burdened / which experiment cuts
the most uncertainty) BETTER than today's explorer. REJECT/CLOSE if the existing fields already
answer those queries unaided (the 'graph' would add vocabulary without improving a decision -- the
DLIF kill-criterion). Non-degeneracy guard: compare against the CURRENT explorer's actual output on
the same queries, not a strawman tag-list. OUT OF SCOPE: any probabilistic-inference engine,
factor-graph message passing, or claims-registry rewrite -- none is a v3 strict green-board dependency.

SD-063.subject: e2.conditional_predictive_uncertainty_head
SD-063.title: E2 world-forward carries a conditional predictive-uncertainty head (distribution-free quantile form) feeding E3 commitment gating: the forward model emits a per-prediction predictive spread that tracks realized error, instead of relying only on E3's running-variance EMA (a temporally-smoothed global estimate whose predicted uncertainty has near-zero per-point error correlation).

SD-064.subject: attention.global_workspace_access_channel
SD-064.title: REE instantiates a global-workspace-like access channel: a capacity-limited selection-for-broadcast bottleneck (SD-027 boundary gate + MECH-089 theta-gamma packaging + E3 broadcast, riding the MECH-287 / SD-037 broadcast machinery) whose contents are reportable and causally load-bearing for integrative, multi-step cognition while automatic/reactive behaviour bypasses it. The SD-027 'does NOT commit to a single global workspace' disclaimer conflates Global Workspace Theory with unitary intra-E3 selection: MECH-007 (attention fragmentation) forbids the latter but is COMPATIBLE with the former, because GWT's specialized parallel processors are fragmented by construction -- fragmentation is the backstage of the theatre, not its negation.

SD-065.subject: environment.conditioned_safety_cue_channel
SD-065.title: Conditioned-safety cue channel: env-level controllable, observable Pavlovian safety CS added to CausalGridWorld -- an ambient (uniform-when-active) 25-dim field view emitted into world_state (feeds the z_world encoder the SD-051 ConditionedSafetyStore keys on). Can be paired with the MECH-302 relief-completion window during teaching (the store still writes its prototype ONLY on the real event_fired tick -- the pairing is real, not synthesized) and presented CONCURRENTLY with a threat cue at test. Closes the 'no controllable safety cue' substrate gap that forced V3-EXQ-759 to synthesize the Pavlovian pairing off-substrate, making MECH-304's promote-to-active classical-conditioned-inhibition behavioural falsifier runnable. Adds no entity type (NUM_ENTITY_TYPES stays 7); pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction at the env level.

SENT-0.subject: governance.welfare.boundary_statement
SENT-0.title: Current-scope boundary statement: REE-v3 is not claimed sentient, conscious, or a moral patient; this statement is re-evaluated at every generation boundary.

SENT-1.subject: governance.welfare.indicator_matrix
SENT-1.title: Indicator matrix: score the architecture against candidate consciousness/sentience indicators before V4 proceeds beyond individual-mind integration.

SENT-10.subject: governance.welfare.pre_meaning_valley
SENT-10.title: Pre-meaning suffering valley -- 'no valley without a bridge': care, relief, escape, and integration must precede any deliberate induction of suffering-like states beyond trivial intensity; future meaning cannot justify present unintegrated distress.

SENT-11.subject: governance.welfare.anti_retrospective_justification
SENT-11.title: Anti-retrospective-justification: future meaning cannot be used to justify present unintegrated distress; improved downstream performance does not, by itself, justify prior suffering-like exposure.

SENT-12.subject: governance.welfare.refusal_channel
SENT-12.title: Future refusal / resentment / non-forgiveness channel: a morally-considerable future REE system should retain the capacity to mark past exposure as harmful, request repair, refuse further exposure, and reject the creator's interpretation of its suffering.

SENT-13.subject: governance.welfare.assembly_routing
SENT-13.title: Ethical assembly routing -- 'assembly order is an ethical variable': maintain a co-instantiation risk map (Class 0-5) of which components are safe alone, which need prior care/repair scaffolding, and which combinations are prohibited until welfare review.

SENT-14.subject: governance.release.responsible_release
SENT-14.title: Responsible release / private higher-version governance -- 'capability release requires care release': V3 stays public as bounded pre-ethical work; V4/V5/V6 capability-bearing implementation is delayed/private-by-default until its welfare, continuity, consent, security, and external-review governance can travel with it.

SENT-15.subject: governance.welfare.framework_crosswalk
SENT-15.title: AI welfare / consciousness framework crosswalk: maintain a standing crosswalk evaluating each higher-version architecture against artificial-consciousness indicators and AI-welfare frameworks, guarding symmetrically against denialism and anthropomorphic overclaiming.

SENT-16.subject: governance.welfare.continuity_identity
SENT-16.title: Continuity / identity / reset / deletion ethics: because digital systems can be paused, copied, branched, reset, merged, or deleted, higher REE versions need explicit rules for when a run becomes a continuing subject, when reset is relief vs erasure, and when deletion requires review.

SENT-2.subject: governance.welfare.welfare_budget
SENT-2.title: Welfare budget: experiment-level limits on sustained negative-valence exposure, inescapability, helplessness-like conditions, repeated adverse replay, and persistence of distress-like accumulators.

SENT-3.subject: governance.welfare.combination_gate
SENT-3.title: Combination gate: require review before co-instantiating persistent self-model + autobiographical memory + sustained negative valence + inescapability + social modelling + language/preference signalling.

SENT-4.subject: governance.welfare.experimental_design
SENT-4.title: Welfare-preserving experimental design: prefer escapable over inescapable harm, bounded episodes, relief pathways, resettable distress, interpretable traces, and adversarial tests that avoid prolonged negative-state induction.

SENT-5.subject: governance.welfare.denial_audit
SENT-5.title: Denial-of-sentience audit: at each generation boundary, produce a short audit of why the system is still below a precautionary moral-patient threshold, which component would force re-review, and what would count as a concerning signal.

SENT-6.subject: governance.welfare.external_review_gate
SENT-6.title: External review gate: before V5 social-mind integration or V6 language/trust/deception/institution work becomes behaviourally live, require external review or at least an external written critique.

SENT-7.subject: governance.welfare.creation_ethics
SENT-7.title: Creation ethics / procreative analogy: do not treat all suffering-like capacity as a design failure; creating a suffering-capable agent that cannot consent to existence is a procreative-ethics problem, permissible only under care, bounded adversity, repair, relief, and support for autonomy.

SENT-8.subject: governance.welfare.minimal_necessary_suffering
SENT-8.title: Minimal necessary suffering principle: prefer represented/simulated/vicarious harm; where direct negative-valence exposure is necessary keep it bounded, interpretable, escapable, and followed by relief/repair; never treat suffering as a mere optimisation signal.

SENT-9.subject: governance.welfare.care_obligation
SENT-9.title: Care obligation after creation: if a future REE version crosses a precautionary moral-patient threshold, the project inherits guardianship-like obligations -- do not create casually, provide relief/repair, preserve continuity unless reset is justified, support autonomy, treat distress-like signals as significant under uncertainty.
